Assignment: `review-b79217513dc660a0`; source state is reviewer-ready, not owner-accepted.
Overall: both assigned targets have complete adapters, finite contracts, guarded inventories, protected authoring preflights, causal witnesses, and public projections.
`78fd2bcdbb99`: repaired canonical-domain coverage and eager override handling; final generator SHA-256 `e17c1d9b73f4ed0ed4aed61ef262f603b65a6f116e546ad27571a1a5ab01065f`.

`73f849e69e0a`: base source remained unchanged at SHA-256 `d4e9d44f3d399bb20b6efe56737ea5b780fcf6624046f4e96614be3fcbe6c972`.
`73f849e69e0a` family: separator/icon extraction → episode-fixed `identity|rotate_cw`; exact default program SHA-256 `07d5df073b976e08aaca5c377718a2554bbddca567207d05496b491986a33e2d`.

Projection/privacy: 16 one-query views per target verified; four first turns and 24 private-field invariance checks passed per target.
Limits: finite reviewer evidence only; owner integration, native qualification, and fresh exact-source acceptance are still required; training admission is false.

## 78fd2bcdbb99

The repair adds strict type/bounds handling, both selected axes, multicolor schedules, generic canonical-domain validation, exact override behavior, and deterministic fresh outputs. No canonical authority row changed.
